command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
path = 'parsing/html/html.go'
s = open(path).read()
old = '''// elements that implicitly close an open p element.
var pClosers = map[string]bool{
\t"div":        true,
\t"ul":         true,
\t"ol":         true,
\t"table":      true,
\t"blockquote": true,
\t"h1":         true,
\t"h2":         true,
\t"h3":         true,
\t"h4":         true,
\t"h5":         true,
\t"h6":         true,
}'''
new = '''// elements that implicitly close an open p element.
var pClosers = map[string]bool{
\t"address":    true,
\t"article":    true,
\t"aside":      true,
\t"blockquote": true,
\t"details":    true,
\t"dialog":     true,
\t"div":        true,
\t"dl":         true,
\t"fieldset":   true,
\t"figcaption": true,
\t"figure":     true,
\t"footer":     true,
\t"form":       true,
\t"h1":         true,
\t"h2":         true,
\t"h3":         true,
\t"h4":         true,
\t"h5":         true,
\t"h6":         true,
\t"header":     true,
\t"hgroup":     true,
\t"hr":         true,
\t"main":       true,
\t"menu":       true,
\t"nav":        true,
\t"ol":         true,
\t"pre":        true,
\t"section":    true,
\t"table":      true,
\t"ul":         true,
}'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(path, 'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w parsing/html/html.go && go build ./parsing/html/ && go test ./parsing/html/ 2>&1 | tail -5
